# Pubbabhāga-namakāra

*Preliminary Homage*

**Handa mayaṁ buddhassa bhagavato pubbabhāga-namakāraṁ karomase**

**Literal:** Come now, we to [the] Buddha, [the] Blessed One, preliminary homage let us make  
**Faithful:** Now let us pay preliminary homage to the Buddha, the Blessed One.  

| Word | Analysis & Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`handa`** | `(interj)` come now, well then; **[handa]** |
| **`mayaṁ`** | `(1st pl nom)` we; **[ahaṁ]** |
| **`buddhassa`** | `(masc dat/gen sg)` to the Buddha, of the Buddha; **[√budh + ta]** |
| **`bhagavato`** | `(masc dat/gen sg)` to the Blessed One; **[√bhaj > bhag + a + vant]** |
| **`pubbabhāga-namakāraṁ`** | `(masc acc sg cmpd)` preliminary homage, homage that comes first; **[pubba + bhāga + namakāra]** |
| ↳ **`pubba`** | `(adj comp)` prior, former; **[pubba, no root in DPD]** |
| ↳ **`bhāga`** | `(masc comp)` part; **[√bhaj + a]** |
| ↳ **`namakāraṁ`** | `(masc acc sg)` homage, act of veneration; **[nama + kāra (√kar + a)]** |
| **`karomase`** | `(1st pl pres mid imperat)` let us make, let us do; **[√kar + o + mase]** |

### Paṭhamo vāro

*(Optional)*

**Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa (×3)**

**Literal:** Homage to that Blessed One, Arahant, Perfectly Self-Awakened One  
**Faithful:** Homage to the Blessed One, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Awakened One.  

| Word | Analysis & Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`namo`** | `(ind)` homage, reverence (to); **[√nam + as + o]** |
| **`tassa`** | `(dem pron masc dat sg)` to that, to him; **[ta]** |
| **`bhagavato`** | `(masc dat sg)` to the Blessed One; **[√bhaj > bhag + a + vant]** |
| **`arahato`** | `(masc dat sg)` to the Arahant, to the Worthy One; **[√arah + ant]** |
| **`sammāsambuddhassa`** | `(masc dat sg comp)` to the Perfectly Self-Awakened One; **[sammā + sambuddha]** |
| ↳ **`sammā`** | `(ind comp)` perfectly, rightly; **[sammā]** |
| ↳ **`sambuddhassa`** | `(masc dat sg)` to the self-awakened one; **[saṁ + √budh + ta]** |

**Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa (×3)**

**Literal:** Homage to that Blessed One, Arahant, Perfectly Self-Awakened One  
**Faithful:** Homage to the Blessed One, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Awakened One.  

*Word analysis as at the first occurrence of this line.*

*AN 11.15*
